candidate_program.name: bounded_weighted_collision_priority
candidate_program.rationale: Scores root reward against weighted competition, applying a bounded discount for heavy mutually conflicting rivals while retaining the strongest-rival floor. Uses local weighted pair structure; quadratic edge work and imperfect overlap estimates may outweigh its usefulness.
candidate_program.rule: weight * (1 + weight) / (1 + weight + max(max_conflict_weight, conflict_weight / (1 + 0.25 * rival_pair_weight_fraction)))

comparison: exact rational comparison of returned binary float scores
cost_scope: Cached offline score-fit evaluation only; does not replace complete-schedule charged cost
